uncited: The method relies on expanding directional signals (such as lighting or view-dependent appearance) into a series of orthogonal basis functions defined on the sphere.
The basis is indexed by a degree $\ell \in \mathbb{N} \cup \{0\}$ and an order $m \in \{-\ell, \dots, \ell\}$.
The total number of basis functions for a maximum degree $L$ is $(L+1)^2$.
